parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path. Per the restraint rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers sample-app-mirror no-action regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. Lifting the production 'MetricRow.body' from 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' into shared code to satisfy this cluster would couple production DebugPanel semantics to a demonstration fixture. The duplication is intentional: the sample app carries its own local copy of the debug HUD to remain self-contained.
